steps.text: Run holo stack up on the mini — Postgres, Mastra, scheduler, zero-cache healthy within 60s
steps.literal_cmd: start=$(python3 -c 'import time;print(int(time.time()*1000))'); out=$(bun services/platform/src/cli/holo.ts stack up 2>&1); ec=$?; end=$(python3 -c 'import time;print(int(time.time()*1000))'); echo "$out"; echo EXIT_$ec; echo ELAPSED_MS=$((end-start)); test $ec -eq 0 && test $((end-start)) -le 60000 && echo "$out" | grep -i postgres | grep -iq healthy && echo "$out" | grep -i mastra | grep -iq healthy && echo STACK_UP_OK

steps.text: Run holo stack down on the mini — all four processes exit clean, zero orphaned PIDs
steps.literal_cmd: out=$(bun services/platform/src/cli/holo.ts stack down 2>&1); ec=$?; echo "$out"; echo EXIT_$ec; test $ec -eq 0 || exit $ec; sleep 1; remaining=$(launchctl list 2>/dev/null | awk '/holocron-(postgres|mastra|zerocache|scheduler)/{print}' || true); echo "REMAINING=$remaining"; test -z "$remaining" && echo STACK_DOWN_OK

steps.text: Run holo stack up on the laptop — identical health result under the same config contract
steps.literal_cmd: out=$(bun services/platform/src/cli/holo.ts stack up 2>&1); ec=$?; echo "$out"; echo EXIT_$ec; test $ec -eq 0 || exit $ec; st=$(bun services/platform/src/cli/holo.ts stack status 2>&1); echo "$st"; echo "$st" | grep -i postgres | grep -iq healthy && echo "$st" | grep -i mastra | grep -iq healthy && echo "$st" | grep -i embed | grep -iq healthy && echo LAPTOP_STACK_UP_OK

steps.text: Run holo secrets doctor — every config value resolves, zero missing keys reported
steps.literal_cmd: out=$(bun services/platform/src/cli/holo.ts secrets doctor 2>&1); ec=$?; echo "$out"; echo EXIT_$ec; test $ec -eq 0 && echo "$out" | grep -Eiq 'keys absent:[[:space:]]*0' && echo "$out" | grep -Eiq 'status:[[:space:]]*OK' && echo SECRETS_DOCTOR_OK

steps.text: Run holo verify-no-convex-env — zero Convex env aliases found across the repo
steps.literal_cmd: out=$(bun services/platform/src/cli/holo.ts verify-no-convex-env 2>&1); ec=$?; echo "$out"; echo EXIT_$ec; test $ec -eq 0 && echo "$out" | grep -iq 'zero Convex env aliases found' && echo VERIFY_NO_CONVEX_OK

steps.text: Kill Mastra mid-run, rerun holo stack up — service restarts, reports healthy, no manual cleanup
steps.literal_cmd: launchctl kill SIGTERM gui/$(id -u)/holocron-mastra 2>/dev/null || launchctl stop gui/$(id -u)/holocron-mastra 2>/dev/null || true; sleep 2; out=$(bun services/platform/src/cli/holo.ts stack up 2>&1); ec=$?; echo "$out"; echo EXIT_$ec; test $ec -eq 0 || exit $ec; st=$(bun services/platform/src/cli/holo.ts stack status 2>&1); echo "$st"; echo "$st" | grep -i mastra | grep -iq healthy && echo MASTRA_RESTART_OK
